callees.name: _clean_domain_context_files
callees.pre_condition: work_dir is a string path to a directory containing the spec_prompts/domain_context/ subdirectory with phase_NN_types.txt files; removed_phase_nums is a list of phase numbers; renumbered is a dict mapping old phase numbers to new phase numbers
callees.post_condition: For each phase number in removed_phase_nums, the file work_dir/spec_prompts/domain_context/phase_{num}_types.txt is deleted. For each (old, new) pair in renumbered where old != new, the file work_dir/spec_prompts/domain_context/phase_{old}_types.txt is renamed to phase_{new}_types.txt. Files for unchanged phases (where old == new) remain unmodified.
